observed_failure: After the reconciliation fixture was initialized correctly, all Pilot 8 cases reached the Pilot 8 mechanism setup and failed while issuing the clean generation-1 composite checkpoint with PermissionError: current promotion lost race.
root_cause: The durable composite journal used sqlite3.Connection.total_changes as though it were the affected-row count for the immediately preceding CURRENT-promotion UPDATE. total_changes is cumulative for the connection, so the preceding INSERT and authentication-tag UPDATE made the clean promotion appear to have affected more than one row. The same faulty affected-row check was also present in PENDING recovery promotion.
classification_basis: This failure is in the Pilot 8 production mechanism's clean issuance/liveness transition after the fixture defect was removed. Prior EXP-I Pilot 1-7 tests remained green in the same run. It is therefore a mechanism defect, not a test-expectation adjustment and not a scientific pass.
allowed_repair: Replace both cumulative Connection.total_changes checks with the rowcount of the exact conditional UPDATE cursor. Do not change any Pilot 8 endpoint, expected outcome, state binding, generation rule, authority boundary, or failure criterion.
